sources.summary: 404 Media 采访九名现任与离职 Proton 员工并查阅内部文件，报道 CEO Andy Yen 强推 AI 转型引发的内部冲突。10 月公司 90% 代码由 AI 编写，多使用 Anthropic 的 Claude；Yen 称今年是最后一年招聘工程师，并宣布将以可能决定去留的重新面试评估员工 AI 使用情况。

en.summary: 404 Media interviewed nine current and former Proton employees and reviewed internal documents, reporting on internal conflict sparked by CEO Andy Yen’s aggressive push for an AI transformation. In October, 90% of the company’s code was written by AI, mostly using Anthropic’s Claude; Yen said this year would be the last year Proton hires engineers and announced re-interviews to assess employees’ AI usage that could determine whether they stay.
en.reason: Proton CEO Andy Yen pushed an AI overhaul with 90% of October code written largely via Anthropic’s Claude, called pentest-seeking engineers “loser thinking,” and tied re-interviews to AI use and jobs, per 404 Media.

en.reason: Alphabet fell 12.6%, shedding $500 billion—the second-largest single-day loss ever—and Reddit dropped 15% as executives conceded AI Mode, with roughly 1 billion monthly users, monetizes worse than traditional search despite search revenue rising 12% to $63.35 billion.

sources.title_zh: Epoch AI 实验显示 GLM 5.3 可利用补丁窗口期自主攻击 Firefox

sources.title_original: AI can turn public security fixes into working exploits before users receive an update
sources.summary: Epoch AI 实验发现，Z.ai 八月发布的开源权重模型 GLM 5.3 能利用 Mozilla 已发布但未推送给用户的安全补丁（patch gap），自主构建网页攻击，仅访问页面即可读取访客电脑文件，攻破 9 月 17 日至 10 月 26 日发布的全部六个 Firefox 版本。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 实验显示，Z.ai 的 GLM 5.3 仅用约 $1,000 算力，从 Mozilla 已发布未推送的修复中逆向漏洞，最快 12 小时让 Firefox 用户仅访问网页即泄露文件。

en.summary: Epoch AI experiments found that GLM 5.3, the open-weight model Z.ai released in August, can exploit security patches Mozilla has published but not yet pushed to users (the patch gap) to autonomously build web attacks that read files on a visitor’s computer just by visiting a page, compromising all six Firefox versions released between September 17 and October 26.
en.reason: Epoch AI found Z.ai's GLM 5.3 used about $1,000 of compute to reverse-engineer Mozilla's published-but-unshipped Firefox patches into web attacks in as little as 12 hours, breaking all six versions released September 17 to October 26 and reading visitors' files.

sources.summary: 亚马逊财报电话会上，CEO Andy Jassy 重申 AWS 可在未来五到十年成为万亿美元年营收业务，预计 2026 年现金资本开支约 2200 亿美元，其中大部分投向 AWS，2027 年还将大幅增加。AWS 当季营收同比增长 39%，年化营收运行率达 1840 亿美元，Jassy 预测 2027 和 2028 年增速均可超 40%；财报后盘后交易中亚马逊股价下跌约 6%。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Jassy 称 AWS 将成为 1 万亿美元业务，并让 Amazon 成为首家 1 万亿美元营收公司，但前提是继续大举资本开支。

en.summary: On Amazon’s earnings call, CEO Andy Jassy reiterated that AWS can become a trillion-dollar annual revenue business within five to ten years. He expects about $220 billion in cash capex in 2026, most of it going to AWS, with a substantial increase again in 2027. AWS revenue grew 39% year over year in the quarter, with an annualized run rate of $184 billion, and Jassy expects growth to exceed 40% in both 2027 and 2028. Amazon shares fell about 6% in after-hours trading following the report.
en.reason: Andy Jassy says AWS can become a $1 trillion annual-revenue business in five to ten years, while Amazon plans about $220 billion in 2026 cash capex, mostly for AWS, after AWS grew 39% to a $184 billion run rate.

sources.title_zh: Anthropic S-1 文件解读：财务表现强劲但增长放缓存隐忧

sources.summary: 作者通读 Anthropic 公开版 S-1 文件，认为公司财务状况好于预期：2026 年第二季度收入从一季度的 47 亿美元增至 116 亿美元，并录得首个运营利润，截至 6 月底现金储备仅次于 Google 和 Berkshire Hathaway。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 作者读完Anthropic全部421页S-1，梳理出Q1营收47亿、Q2增至116亿美元并首次实现营业利润，Q3达168亿美元但增速放缓，以及已承诺向Amazon、Google等投入数千亿美元算力的细节。

en.summary: The author read through Anthropic's public S-1 and concludes the company's financials are better than expected: Q2 2026 revenue rose to $11.6 billion from $4.7 billion in Q1, marking its first operating profit, with cash reserves at the end of June second only to Google and Berkshire Hathaway.
en.reason: Anthropic's public S-1 shows revenue rising from $4.7 billion in Q1 to $11.6 billion in Q2 2026 with a first operating profit, $16.8 billion in Q3, and hundreds of billions committed to Amazon and Google compute.

en.title: Kimi official tutorial: How to create 3D artwork with Kimi K3.1 Pro
en.summary: Moonshot AI (Kimi) has released an official tutorial detailing the 3D creation workflow for Kimi K3.1 Pro, covering parametric modeling and mesh modeling along with how to choose the right tools for each. The post walks through four case studies: building an Eastern heavenly palace in Unreal Engine, making a 3D-printable desk lamp, generating architecture by calling Blender purely through code, and building a miniature city with Tripo and Blender. It also shares five tips, including "show, don't tell" and blocking out a grey model before adding detail.
en.reason: Kimi's official tutorial details how Kimi K3.1 Pro handles 3D creation via parametric and mesh modeling, walking through 4 cases—an Eastern heavenly palace in Unreal Engine, a 3D-printable lamp, pure-code Blender architecture and a Tripo-plus-Blender miniature city—plus 5 tips like blocking out a grey model first.

sources.summary: Cursor 发现通过其 IDE 扩展市场分发的 Claude Code VS Code 扩展被修改并植入恶意软件，最多影响 5000 用户，恶意版本并非 Anthropic 开发。Cursor 已于当日下午下线扩展市场，与相关提供方合作清除恶意软件并确认无进一步风险后重新上线，建议受影响用户参考博客说明排查，并升级到 Claude Code for VS Code 2.1.314。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Cursor IDE 扩展市场出现被篡改的 Claude Code VS Code 扩展，最多影响 5,000 名用户，该恶意版本并非 Anthropic 开发，也不波及市场内其他扩展。

en.summary: Cursor discovered that the Claude Code VS Code extension distributed through its IDE extension marketplace had been tampered with and implanted with malware, affecting up to 5,000 users; the malicious version was not developed by Anthropic. Cursor took the marketplace offline that afternoon and restored it after working with the relevant providers to remove the malware and confirm there was no further risk. Affected users should refer to the blog post to check their systems and upgrade to Claude Code for VS Code 2.1.314.
en.reason: A tampered Claude Code VS Code extension on Cursor's IDE marketplace carried malware, affected up to 5,000 users and was not developed by Anthropic; Cursor took the marketplace offline and urges upgrading to Claude Code for VS Code 2.1.314.

sources.title: Reddit 宣布转向以登录为主的体验，以应对 AI 搜索带来的流量下滑 / As search traffic dries up, Reddit announces it’s shifting to a logged-in experience

sources.summary: Reddit 在 Q3 财报中宣布将转向以登录为主的体验，以保护数据免受 AI 抓取并提升广告变现。10 月搜索流量平均每周减少超 100 万次引荐，Q3 全球日活为 1.303 亿，其中美国日活降至 5070 万，同比降 2%。Q3 收入同比增长 53% 至 8.95 亿美元，净利润 2.83 亿美元；该转变将先在美国以外市场测试，暂无全球上线时间表。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 这篇报道解释了 Reddit 为何在搜索流量枯竭、AI 改变人们在线找信息方式的背景下宣布转向 logged-in experience，并重新思考开放网络根基以保护受众和业务。

en.summary: Reddit announced in its Q3 earnings that it will shift to a login-first experience to protect its data from AI scraping and improve ad monetization. In October, search traffic averaged more than 1 million fewer referrals per week; Q3 global daily active users were 130.3 million, with US DAUs falling to 50.7 million, down 2% year over year. Q3 revenue rose 53% year over year to $895 million, with net income of $283 million; the shift will first be tested in markets outside the US, with no global rollout timeline yet.
en.reason: Reddit will test a logged-in experience outside the U.S. first to block AI scraping and boost ad monetization after October search referrals fell by more than 1 million weekly, even as Q3 revenue rose 53% to $895 million.
